Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Floral Kaleidoscope Traditional Runner, 2'2" x 7'6", Blue Multi
Colors: Denim
Materials: stone
With its gorgeous floral designs in striking color palettes of gold and red on a distressed blue field, this rug will impart a robust element to any setting. The powerloomed fiber blend ensures durability and beauty. 2'2" x 7'6" 75% polypropylene, 25% polyester Powerloomed construction in Turkey Medium pile height makes it durable and easy to vacuum Vacuum, professionally clean Pair with a rug pad, which is sold separately Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
